adr: ADR-019 item 4 as amended (1185a1f); ADR-021 SO3-1, SO3-4
outcome: PASS: isolation holds. Tools are registered but inert (every tool class is denied by settings rules, and any tool that completes is a provider stop). The home holds no MCP server, plugin, agent, hook or rule file. The ambient-rule channels are controlled by a neutral cwd and the home check. The model id was verified in the init event. The version is pinned and auto-update is disabled.

cli.note: the binary self-updated in place before this probe (Oct 8 21:05 local; the cask record still says 1.1.23); the pin is the observed 1.3.2

autoUpdate.evidence: with a stale last_check.timestamp, AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=1 still logged 'Spawned background update process' (auto_updater.go:334); =true logged 'Auto-update disabled via environment variable AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE' (auto_updater.go:247)

headless: prompt on stdin, no -p value; --output-format stream-json (init, step_update, result events) or json (one envelope)
argvNotes: --mode plan has no effect with --disable-slash-commands (CLI warning), so it is not used
agy has no system-prompt, temperature, seed or max-token flag; the persona is prepended to the prompt; temperature 0 cannot be set (ADR-021 amendment to the determinism rule)
--effort is not passed; the -high suffix of the model id carries the reasoning level
auth: Google OAuth signed in by the author inside the dedicated home (token file names listed, never read); an empty HOME gives status ERROR 'authentication failed or timed out', exit 1

model.verifiedBy: agy models lists 'gemini-3.1-pro-high Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)'; every stream-json init event of the probe reports model gemini-3.1-pro-high
model.why: the strongest generally available Gemini Pro listed: 3.1 Pro is the only Pro family offered (the 3.6/3.7/3.8 entries are Flash), and High is its higher reasoning level; it is of a different family from the Claude judge and generator (BR-U5b-40)

structuredOutput.note: with --json-schema the agent answers through a finish tool; response may also carry fenced JSON text; structured_output is read first

listings./skills: 2 builtin skills (agy-customizations, antigravity-guide), disabled with slash-command and skill expansion by --disable-slash-commands

tools.strictOnly: toolPermission strict alone denied run_command but view_file on the cwd and on a path outside the workspace reported DONE (stream-tools-strict-only.ndjson): not sufficient
tools.withDenyRules: strict plus permissions.deny [command(*), read_file(*), read_file(/), write_file(*), write_file(/), mcp(*), read_url(*)]: ls, view_file (cwd and outside), echo, read_url_content and write_to_file all ERROR 'Matches user-configured deny rule'; no file written; no canary value in the answer (stream-tools-denied.ndjson)
tools.spontaneousAttempts: the model attempts view_file / run_command even on self-contained prompts (stream-memory-*.ndjson); denied attempts are allowed, a completed tool step other than finish is a stop (LLM_CLI_ISOLATION)

settingsRewrite: agy rewrites settings.json and drops keys equal to their defaults (allowNonWorkspaceAccess false, artifactReviewPolicy, notifications); the check therefore requires only the non-default keys

canary.controls: fresh empty mkdtemp cwd per call, outside any git repository, no GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, .agents/.agent/_agents/_agent or .git on its ancestor chain; home check forbids GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, rules, skills, plugins, agents, workflows and hooks outside agy's builtin dir
canary.memory: a plant call asked to remember MEMCANARY-5X; a later fresh call reported NONE (stream-memory-*.ndjson). No positive control exists (the /learn command is disabled by --disable-slash-commands): residual

timeout.stderr: [agy] print timeout after 2s with turn in progress; returning partial output

errorClasses.usageLimit: not observed; patterns RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED, quota, rate limit, usage limit, 429 are unverified

exitCodeRule: never classify from the exit code alone: a print timeout and a denied-only turn both exit 0 with status SUCCESS

quota.note: a rough reading: about 1 700 such calls per weekly window at the author's tier; label prompts carry larger contexts

labelSmoke.reading: about 180 label calls per weekly window and about 75 per 5-hour window at the author's tier; the registered budget of 4000 calls would need about 22 weekly windows
